definition: A node is regoverned when its constrainedBy list changes, so a claim that still says the same thing now answers to different claims above it.
name: regoverned

rejected.because: Reparented borrows a tree's word, and a node here is allowed many parents at once.
rejected.name: reparented

rejected.because: Moved suggests the node went somewhere, and it stays exactly where it was.
rejected.name: moved
